Urban Concierge Brief: SF Bay Area

Tuesday Nov 3 – Thursday Nov 5, 2026 · Snapshot compiled Mon Nov 2, 2026, 10:10 pm PT (BayAreaDailySync)

What changed since the last brief (Mon 2:05 pm): No major changes. No new Caltrans District 4 posts, the NWS forecast and Beach Hazards Statement are unchanged, and BART shows only its planned Millbrae–SFO–Daly City delays. Monday night's games and Día de los Muertos procession have passed and are dropped; the window now runs Tue–Thu.

Weather and alerts

NWS (SF, forecast updated 2:35 pm Mon): Tonight mostly cloudy, low around 55, 20% chance of showers after 5 am. Tuesday showers (90%), high near 65 falling to about 61 in the afternoon, under a tenth of an inch. Tuesday night 30% chance of showers before 9 pm, low around 54. Wednesday sunny, high near 67; Wednesday night partly cloudy, low around 54. Thursday sunny, high near 69; Thursday night mostly clear, low around 55.
Source: https://forecast.weather.gov/MapClick.php?lat=37.7749&lon=-122.4194&unit=0&lg=english&FcstType=text&TextType=1

Beach Hazards Statement (issued 5:08 am Mon), in effect until Tue Nov 3, 8 pm: sneaker waves and strong rip currents on SF and Monterey Bay coasts. Stay off jetties and rocks at Ocean Beach.
Source: https://api.weather.gov/alerts/active?point=37.7749,-122.4194

Road closures

  • SF, Wed Nov 4, Valkyries parade: northbound Embarcadero and eastbound King (3rd & King to Broadway), Market (Drumm to Steuart), Steuart and Spear closed 12:01 am–4 pm; southbound Embarcadero, westbound King, Washington, Mission, Howard, Folsom, Harrison, Bryant (Main to Embarcadero), Brannan, Townsend and Second (Brannan to King) closed 8 am–4 pm. https://www.sfmta.com/travel-updates/valkyries-wnba-championship-parade-wednesday-november-4-2026
  • US-101 Marin County: nightly lane and ramp closures 10 pm–6 am (some ramps from 8 pm) through Sat Nov 7 morning (San Rafael/Novato-area ramps including Sir Francis Drake, Lucas Valley and N. San Pedro). https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-10-30-us101-nightly-lane-ramp-closures-capm
  • San Mateo: one lane of EB SR-92 closed Thu night 10 pm–7 am; one SB US-101 lane closed Thu Nov 5, 10 pm–5 am. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-10-30-sr92-us101-ramp-lane-closures
  • SR-82 (El Camino Real), Burlingame: northbound lanes closed Rosedale Ave to Carmelita Ave through Fri Nov 6, 9 am–6 pm, for tree work; detour via California Drive. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-11-01-sr82-short-term-closure-ecr-tree-work
  • US-101 San Mateo County (South SF to East Palo Alto): intermittent lane and ramp closures weeknights 9 pm–5 am through Nov 24 and Nov 30, plus partial daytime ramp closures 7 am–3 pm. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-11-01-us101-ramp-lane-closures
  • SR-17 near Hebard Rd, Lexington Hills: rolling overnight lane closures for striping (NB 8 pm–6 am, SB 9 pm–7 am). https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-10-30-sr17-lane-closures--road-rehabilitation-project
  • SR-9 near Saratoga (Toll Gate Rd to SR-35): one-way traffic control 8 am–4 pm for about 10 days from Nov 2. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-10-30-sr9-lane-clsoure
  • SR-29 (Sonoma Blvd), Vallejo: two lanes closed (one open) through Nov 6, daytime. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-10-23-sr29-daytime-two-lane-closure
  • SR-37 west of Vallejo: temporary 45 mph layout; eastbound Walnut Ave exit to Mare Island closed (detour via Wilson Ave). https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-10-29-sr37-paving-project
  • SR-37 Petaluma River Bridge: one lane each way nightly through Nov 7. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-10-29-sr37-petaluma-river-bridge
  • Looking ahead: SR-1 Devil's Slide tunnels close Thu Nov 5, 8 pm – Fri 4 am · SB US-101 Hospital Curve closes Fri Nov 6, 11 pm – Mon Nov 9, 6 am · WB Bay Bridge YBI on-ramp closed Thu Nov 12 night · Appian Way overcrossing at I-80, Pinole, closed Fri Nov 13, 9 pm – Mon Nov 16, 4 am · westbound Richmond–San Rafael Bridge closed Sat Nov 14, 11 pm – Sun Nov 15, 8 am.
  • Live conditions: https://quickmap.dot.ca.gov and 511.org.

What's on (each confirmed on an official page)

1) Election Day: Tue Nov 3. California General Election and SF Consolidated General Election. Check polling places and hours with the SF Department of Elections. Bring an umbrella: showers are 90% likely.
https://www.sos.ca.gov/elections/upcoming-elections · https://www.sf.gov/departments/department-elections

2) Golden State Valkyries WNBA Championship Parade: Wed Nov 4, 12 pm. Starts at the Ferry Building and runs along the northbound side of The Embarcadero to Second Street. Free to watch. Sunny, high near 67.
https://www.sfmta.com/travel-updates/valkyries-wnba-championship-parade-wednesday-november-4-2026

Only two events in the Tue–Thu window are confirmed on official pages this run; the Sharks are on the road (at Los Angeles Wed night, per the NHL schedule feed), and Thursday's Warriors game is still unconfirmed (see Not verified). Coming up this weekend per SFMTA: Veterans Day Parade Sun Nov 8 and Head West Marketplace Sun Nov 8. https://www.sfmta.com/travel-updates

Where to eat

No Yelp ratings (Yelp blocks automated loads). Michelin pages not re-opened this run; picks carried from earlier briefs.

Kin Khao, Union Square, SF (Parc 55 hotel, 55 Cyril Magnin St) · Thai · Michelin One Star. Michelin praises its "layered, vibrantly flavorful Thai cooking" with a produce-driven northern bent. +1 415-362-7456. https://guide.michelin.com/us/en/california/san-francisco/restaurant/kin-khao

Rich Table, Hayes Valley, SF (199 Gough St) · Californian · in the Michelin Guide. A "petite Hayes Valley delight" that is packed nightly; near Civic Center. +1 415-355-9085. https://guide.michelin.com/us/en/california/san-francisco/restaurant/rich-table

Zuni Café, Market St, SF (1658 Market St) · Californian · in the Michelin Guide. Michelin calls it a San Francisco institution with a laid-back California vibe and locally sourced food, in an iconic, art-filled space. +1 415-552-2522. https://guide.michelin.com/us/en/california/san-francisco/restaurant/zuni-cafe

La Taqueria, Mission, SF (2889 Mission St) · Mexican · in the Michelin Guide. A local favorite that "always has a queue." (415) 285-7117. https://guide.michelin.com/us/en/california/san-francisco/restaurant/la-taqueria

Muni and cable cars (carried): $2.85 single ride with Clipper, MuniMobile or tap-to-pay ($3.00 cash), good 120 minutes. Day pass $5.70. Cable car $9.00. Visitor Passports 1-day $15, 3-day $35, 7-day $47. Youth 18 and under ride free. https://www.sfmta.com/getting-around/muni/fares
Muni reroutes: Wed: the F, N, 2, 9, 9R, 12, 14, 14R and 15 are adjusted 5 am–3 pm for the parade (buses run F line service all day). https://www.sfmta.com/travel-updates/valkyries-wnba-championship-parade-wednesday-november-4-2026

BART:

  • At 10:10 pm Mon the BART advisory feed shows only the planned 30-minute delays between Millbrae, SFO and Daly City from 9 pm Sun–Thu.
  • Yellow Line late-night single tracking in Contra Costa County through Nov 6 (carried).
  • Powell St. Station entrance at 4th and Market closed through Nov 10 (carried).
  • Coming up: reduced BART-to-OAK service the night of Nov 4 · more Yellow Line late-night single tracking Nov 12–13 · 24th St–Daly City bus bridge Nov 14–15 · Transbay Tube single tracking Nov 21.
    Sources: https://www.bart.gov/schedules/advisories · https://www.bart.gov/guide/airport

Bikes and scooters (from the Oct 23 brief): Lyft Bike $1 to unlock plus $0.19/min classic or $0.49/min ebike, or a $15 day pass. Lime and Spin hold SF permits. No sidewalk riding. https://www.lyft.com/bikes/bay-wheels

Per SF Travel, Union Square has most major hotels and the best transit links (note the Powell BART entrance closure at 4th and Market through Nov 10). SoMa waterfront and Embarcadero hotels sit inside Wednesday's parade closures, so expect limited car access there 8 am–4 pm Wednesday. https://www.sftravel.com/neighborhoods

  4. Election Day polling hours not checked.
